subject: Unexpected tiered seller fee on April marketplace invoice — request to reflow
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@supernova-cloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@supernova-cloud.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on April marketplace invoice — double fee tiers on same SKU

Hi Ben / Marissa,

We ran the April Marketplace invoice and noticed ~3 line items where the same SKU shows two different seller fee tiers applied (standard 12% and a temporary promotional 5%). Net effect is an unexpected negative adjustment on our payout and a mismatch compared to our internal ledger.

I've attached the PDF invoice and a CSV extract of the metering lines we exported from AWS Marketplace for April. Can your team confirm whether Redwood applied a promotional pricing rule at invoice generation or whether this is a metering duplication?

Impact: ~USD 11,800 shortfall on the payout scheduled next week. We need a reconciliation path + timeline by COB tomorrow so we can inform our finance team.

Thanks,
Emma Lopez
Head of Billing Operations
SuperNova Cloud
attachments: SN-INV-20270401-0421.pdf (invoice PDF), metering_export_SN_202704.csv (CSV export)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@supernova-cloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 19:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on April marketplace invoice — double fee tiers on same SKU

Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and for the files.

Quick summary of next steps I propose so we can move fast:
1) Jonas will pull the server-side metering traces for the three suspicious SKUs (meter IDs you provided) and confirm if duplicate usage rows were ingested or reprocessed.
2) Our billing engine team will run the invoice reflow against the April runbook to see whether a promo override flag was applied during finalization.
3) If it's an invoice-side calculation issue, we can issue a corrected credit memo and push an amended payout; if it's a metering duplication, we'll provide the evidence bundle for your ledger reconcile and propose a one-off adjustment.

Can you confirm the exact meter IDs in the CSV that represent the three affected lines (column headers: meter_id, usage_timestamp, quantity)? If you can drop those meter_ids in a reply I'll prioritize the trace collection.

I know timing is tight — I'll aim to have an initial readback by 10:00 AM PDT tomorrow.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0149

On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 5:12 PM Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@supernova-cloud.com> wrote:
> (attached invoice + CSV)

From: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@supernova-cloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 06:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on April marketplace invoice — double fee tiers on same SKU

Ben — thanks. The three meter_ids are: 78a2c1, 78a2c1-dup, 9f3b4d.
The CSV rows are small; looks like one of our ingestion jobs retried and wrote a duplicate line for meter 78a2c1 with a different pricing tag.

We've also attached a short reconciliation CSV with our ledger calculation columns for those rows. If Redwood can confirm whether the promo 5% was applied by your invoice pipeline or if the duplicate line caused the lower payout, that helps us decide whether to accept an adjustment or ask for a corrected invoice.

Emma

> On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 7:03 PM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Quick summary of next steps...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@supernova-cloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on April marketplace invoice — double fee tiers on same SKU

Emma — quick status:
• Jonas confirmed from the metering traces that meter 78a2c1 appears twice in our ingestion window due to a retry that had an older pricing tag. The invoice engine used the two lines as distinct usage events and the promotional discount was only attached to the retry row, hence the effective blended fee you observed.
• Billing team has queued a corrected invoice and credit memo. We plan to: issue an amended invoice (SN-INV-20270401-0421-AMEND), generate a credit memo for the over-reduced fee (~USD 11,825), and apply it to the May payout so your AR does not need manual intervention this week.

Action items / timeline:
- Today EOD (Apr 22): Redwood billing will publish the amended invoice PDF + credit memo to DocuSign/Portal and notify your AP contact.
- Apr 25: Adjusted payout reflected in the remittance run (we'll confirm once ACH posts).
- Jonas will share the ingestion trace bundle and a short note to your ledger team with the root-cause (retry semantics + pricing-tag mismatch).

If you need the credit memo sooner for internal reconciliation, we can expedite and send an advance memo via email — let me know.

Thanks for flagging this quickly, and apologies for the disruption. I'll follow up once the amended documents are available.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
attachments: SN-INV-20270401-0421-AMEND.pdf (amended invoice), SN-CM-20270422-01.pdf (credit memo)
